title: 安蓓萨·暖茶与线团
description: 银白卷发安蓓萨穿厚实护甲外衣，在长椅上研究一团毛线，双刃安稳挂在架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Ambessa is a powerful older dark-skinned woman with a broad strong build, closely swept silver-white curls, a lined dignified face, and dark Noxian armor accented with red cloth and metal. Her outfit fully covers torso and legs while preserving her commanding silhouette. Her distinctive paired curved drakehound blades hang motionless on a sturdy equipment stand, their connecting elements neatly gathered.
art_direction.scene: She sits comfortably on a broad wooden bench, reading the shape of an unfinished knitted scarf in her hands with amused concentration. A round yarn basket and a cup of tea sit on a nearby table. The carefully stored blades remain behind the bench. One soft curtain and afternoon light turn the formidable character into an approachable peaceful presence.
art_direction.palette: deep burgundy, warm brown, silver gray, honey cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
